name: Insightful Fighting
desc: As a Bonus Action, you make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature you can see that isn't Incapacitated, contested by its Charisma (Deception). On a success, you can use Sneak Attack against it even if you don't have Advantage (but not if you have Disadvantage). This lasts 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.
